templates.name: Top N by Metric
templates.description: Get top N items by a metric (e.g., price, count)
templates.template: SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY {metric} DESC LIMIT {n}

templates.name: Time Series Analysis
templates.description: Analyze data over time with grouping
templates.template: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('{granularity}', {date_column}) as date, SUM({metric}) as total FROM {table} WHERE {date_column} >= '{start_date}' AND {date_column} <= '{end_date}' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

templates.name: Count by Category
templates.description: Count records grouped by a category column
templates.template: SELECT {category_column}, COUNT(*) as count FROM {table} GROUP BY {category_column} ORDER BY count DESC

templates.name: Average by Category
templates.description: Calculate average of a metric grouped by category
templates.template: SELECT {category_column}, AVG({metric_column}) as average FROM {table} GROUP BY {category_column} ORDER BY average DESC

templates.name: Filtered Search
templates.template: SELECT * FROM {table} WHERE {conditions} ORDER BY {order_by} LIMIT {limit}

templates.name: Join Tables
templates.description: Join two tables with a common key
